data.name: Refund captured payment
data.description: Refunds a captured payment, by ID. For a full refund, include an empty payload in the JSON request body. For a partial refund, include an amount object in the JSON request body.
data.evaluateGuide:
Refunds a captured PayPal payment by capture ID, either fully or partially, using the payload to specify a partial amount.
Use for: full payment refunds, partial payment refunds, reversing captured payments
Not supported: payment capture, payment detail lookup, token management

data.name: Refunds
data.description: Use this API to refund payments to customers and reverse transfers from linked accounts.
data.evaluateGuide:
Refunds a Razorpay payment by payment ID and can reverse transfers from linked accounts.
Use for: customer payment refunds, reversing linked-account transfers, issuing payment reversals
Not supported: payment creation, payment capture, payment status lookup

data.name: Show captured payment details
data.description: Shows details for a captured payment, by ID.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves details for a captured PayPal payment by capture ID, enabling agents to inspect its response data.
Use for: checking capture details, retrieving payment status, inspecting captured payment data
Not supported: refunds, payment capture, payment token management

data.name: Refund a payment
data.description: Refunds a payment that has been captured, and returns a unique reference for this request. You get the outcome of the request asynchronously, in a REFUND webhook.  You can refund either the full captured amount or a part of the captured amount. You can also perform multiple partial refunds, as long as their sum doesn't exceed the cap
data.evaluateGuide:
Initiates a full or partial refund for a captured Adyen payment and provides the outcome asynchronously through a refund webhook.
Use for: full refunds, partial refunds, repeated partial refunds
Not supported: payment authorization, payment capture, synchronous refund results

data.name: List all payment tokens for customer
data.description: Returns all payment tokens for a customer.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists all PayPal payment tokens associated with a specified customer.
Use for: listing customer payment tokens, reviewing saved payment methods, retrieving token records
Not supported: creating tokens, deleting tokens, processing payments

data.name: Refund Returned Scenario
data.evaluateGuide:
Runs the GoCardless refund-returned scenario simulator for testing a refund that is returned.
Use for: simulating returned refunds, testing refund failure handling, validating webhook flows
Not supported: live refunds, customer payment processing, production settlement

data.evaluateGuide:
Runs the GoCardless refund-paid scenario simulator for testing a refund that completes successfully.
Use for: simulating paid refunds, testing successful refund handling, validating webhook flows
